runners_data.name: Bontessony Doll
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced 7-year-old with unknown style but trainer struggles recently with poor 14-day record

runners_data.name: Colegram
runners_data.note: Unknown quantity returning from 67-day break with no clear running style pattern established

runners_data.name: Dancing Dame
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse needing strong pace but trainer James Owen firing at 11% strike rate

runners_data.name: Medina Blue
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare with 3lb claimer but concerning fade pattern and 21 days since last run

runners_data.name: Doobeedee
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 225-day layoff with documented finishing problems

runners_data.name: Likewhatyousee
runners_data.note: Prominent 3-year-old with mixed form but trainer struggling with 0/4 recent record

runners_data.name: Princess Of Ballea
runners_data.note: Unknown running style with headgear first-time but limited winning experience

runners_data.name: Steal A Glance
runners_data.note: Likely leader with 54-day break but proven front-running ability and strong pilot

races.paceDynamic: Steal A Glance is the only confirmed front runner and will face no early pressure, allowing her to dictate terms throughout. Lady Kara and Likewhatyousee as prominent runners may track but neither appears aggressive enough to challenge the pace. The hold-up quartet of Dancing Dame, Medina Blue, and Doobeedee will need the leaders to come back to them in the final furlong. This sustainable tempo strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and hold-up horses who get the right tactical ride.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Steal A Glance gets an easy lead and maintains stamina
scenarios.body: The 4-year-old controls the race wire-to-wire with no serious pace pressure until too late. Her sustainable gallop and Sam Twiston-Davies' tactical awareness prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly pedestrian early
scenarios.body: Dancing Dame or Medina Blue benefit from a crawling tempo that sets up their finishing kicks. The lack of early pace allows closers to unleash devastating late runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Kara travels strongly behind Steal A Glance
scenarios.body: The prolific winner uses her recent form advantage to strike past a weakening leader. Her proven 2-mile stamina and Rian Corcoran's 5lb claim provide the edge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lightly-Raced Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Bontessony Doll or Colegram show hidden improvement
scenarios.body: One of the unknown quantities produces a career-best performance with Harry Skelton's guidance on Colegram particularly dangerous. Their fresh conditions and low expectations create upset potential.

watchPoints.text: Steal A Glance breaks cleanly and establishes comfortable lead without pressure through first mile
Lady Kara travels smoothly in second tracking the leader approaching the final hurdle
Dancing Dame gets clear run up the inner rail in final 2 furlongs as gaps appear
Colegram shows early pace despite unknown running style suggesting hidden ability
Doobeedee shows any signs of ring-rustiness after 225-day absence in preliminary stages

races.name: William Hill Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Groom De Cotte
runners_data.note: Recent Huntingdon winner with proven finishing kick but needs to overcome 10-year-old legs in a sprint finish

runners_data.name: Jack's Jury
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up performer for in-form Barry Murphy yard but hasn't won since 2023 and questions remain over stamina at this trip

runners_data.name: Final Entry
runners_data.note: David Pipe inmate who could benefit from stable's tactical approach but poor recent form suggests decline from previous level

runners_data.name: Winning Paddy
runners_data.note: Fresh off 9-day break following impressive 26-length Huntingdon win, perfectly weighted at bottom of handicap with strong finishing speed

runners_data.name: Hurst Hill
runners_data.note: Consistent performer for improving Seamus Mullins stable with solid recent placings but lacks a decisive finishing kick

runners_data.name: Bits Ballou
runners_data.note: Longest absence of 33 days but carries significant weight advantage and Sam Twiston-Davies booking suggests stable confidence

races.paceDynamic: With all six runners showing hold-up tendencies and no confirmed front runner, this will develop into a tactical crawl through the early stages. Groom De Cotte, Jack's Jury and Final Entry will likely drift along in a loose pack, creating minimal early pressure over this staying trip. The absence of natural pace-setters means the field will bunch up entering the final mile, setting up a frantic sprint finish where positioning and tactical nous become critical. This race shape strongly favours horses with proven finishing kicks who can quicken from off the pace when the tempo inevitably lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Finish
scenarios.trigger: If no horse commits to making the running early and they go a pedestrian gallop
scenarios.body: The pace will be funeral-slow until someone panics approaching two out, creating a mad dash where the best finisher prevails. Recent winner Winning Paddy and consistent finisher Hurst Hill are perfectly suited to this developing sprint.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: David Pipe Takes Control
scenarios.trigger: If Jack Tudor on Final Entry gets aggressive earlier than usual to utilise the stable's tactical acumen
scenarios.body: The David Pipe-trained gelding could steal a march by quickening the tempo from three out, stretching the field. This would favour Final Entry's stamina reserves over 3m2½f and potentially catch the others napping in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Experience Tells Late
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a pure test of who handles pressure best in a bunched finish
scenarios.body: The two 10-year-old campaigners will use their racecourse savvy to find the gaps that matter. Groom De Cotte's recent Huntingdon win shows he retains his finishing kick, while veteran nous could prove decisive in a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Twiston-Davies Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Sam Twiston-Davies produces Bits Ballou with a perfectly-timed challenge from the rear
scenarios.body: The lightest-weighted runner could benefit from the tactical nature and his jockey's big-race experience. The 12lb weight advantage over the top-rated pair might prove telling if the pace collapses completely and becomes a pure sprint.

watchPoints.text: Winning Paddy could be overbet following his dominant last win but the form looks rock-solid and the quick turnaround suggests connections are confident
Jack's Jury has been off since November and might need the run despite his hold-up style suiting the likely tactical nature
Final Entry represents the David Pipe stable who excel in tactical scenarios but his recent form figures suggest he may be past his best
The going could deteriorate if rain arrives, potentially favouring Groom De Cotte and Hurst Hill who have better soft ground form
Bits Ballou carries the lightest weight but his 33-day break might leave him short of full fitness in what could become a sprint

races.name: Olympus Plant & Tool Hire Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Linden Lane
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with highest rating who should benefit from the expected lack of pace but hasn't won in recent form

runners_data.name: Crab Road
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with a fatal flaw of fading in the finish, making the likely sprint finish scenario dangerous

runners_data.name: Ask Peter
runners_data.note: Proven hold-up performer at this trip with solid recent form who could benefit from the tactical nature

runners_data.name: Coup De Gold
runners_data.note: Veteran hold-up horse returning after 237 days off with decent course form but fitness concerns

runners_data.name: Blue Siam
runners_data.note: Young hold-up horse with recent run advantage and improving form who could benefit from a messy pace

runners_data.name: Minnie Belle
runners_data.note: Lightest weight hold-up horse but lacks the class edge needed in what will likely become a sprint finish

races.paceDynamic: With all six runners carrying hold-up styles, this race will drift into a crawling pace with no natural front-runner to establish tempo. Linden Lane, Crab Road, and Ask Peter will likely find themselves reluctantly closer to the pace by default, but none wants to make the running. The lack of pace-forcing runners creates a tactical mess where positioning becomes critical over the final 3-4 furlongs. This setup heavily favours horses with the best turn of foot and tactical speed, as the race will inevitably become a sprint finish from the back of the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If no horse takes up the running early and the field bunches together
scenarios.body: The pace collapses completely and it becomes a pure sprint finish where class and finishing kick matter most. Linden Lane's higher rating and Ask Peter's proven ability at the trip give them significant advantages in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Messy Mid-Race Positioning
scenarios.trigger: If the lack of pace creates interference and poor positioning turning for home
scenarios.body: Several runners get trapped behind faltering leaders and the race becomes about who gets the clearest run. Fresh legs and good positioning become more important than pure class in the scramble.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Reluctant Early Leader Folds
scenarios.trigger: If one horse is forced to make running but lacks the stamina to sustain it
scenarios.body: The reluctant pace-setter sets up the race perfectly for the hold-up horses but burns out in the final furlong. Crab Road's tendency to fade late makes this outcome costly for any early positioning.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: True Staying Test
scenarios.trigger: If the genuine pace somehow emerges despite the lack of front-runners
scenarios.body: The race becomes a proper test of stamina where trip specialists can exploit their advantage. This unlikely scenario would favor the most proven stayers at the distance.

watchPoints.text: Crab Road's tendency to fade in the finish makes the likely sprint scenario extremely dangerous for backers
The complete lack of pace-setters could create a stop-start race with interference problems turning for home
Coup De Gold returning after 237 days off faces a tactical race where fitness will be tested late
Blue Siam's recent runs and light weight could be significant advantages if the pace collapses completely
Ask Peter's proven trip form gives him an edge if this somehow becomes a genuine staying test

races.name: execontainers.com Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Morning Mayhem
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter with moderate early speed but faces a significant class deficit against these rivals despite recent winning form

runners_data.name: Donnie Azoff
runners_data.note: Patient hold-up performer whose 38-day break could be ideal given his age, with headgear applied and Jamie Snowden's strong stable form

runners_data.name: Dream Diamond
runners_data.note: Prominent racer returning from 39-day break but boasts the best recent course form and should appreciate this intermediate trip

runners_data.name: Siam Park
runners_data.note: Another prominent type carrying bottom weight for in-form Joe Tizzard, though the recent fall adds a question mark over confidence

runners_data.name: Almuhit
runners_data.note: Sharp prominent racer who won impressively just two days ago and Harry Cobden's booking suggests strong stable confidence

runners_data.name: Three Pikes
runners_data.note: Non-runner declared, removing another prominent racer from an already small field

races.paceDynamic: Morning Mayhem will set a measured early pace from the front with no obvious pace rivals in this small field of six. The prominent racers Dream Diamond, Siam Park, and Almuhit will settle just behind the leader, while only Donnie Azoff brings true hold-up tactics to the contest. With such a modest pace likely through the early stages, this becomes a test of who can quicken best from the 2-furlong pole. This race shape clearly favours the prominent racers who can sit close enough to strike when the pace lifts, rather than Morning Mayhem who may lack the class edge or Donnie Azoff who faces a significant task from the rear.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace remains steady until the 2-furlong pole as expected
scenarios.body: Dream Diamond or Almuhit can position perfectly behind Morning Mayhem before unleashing superior finishing speed. Their class edge tells when the race develops into a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Tactics Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If Morning Mayhem sets an even more sedate pace than anticipated
scenarios.body: Donnie Azoff gets the perfect setup for his patient style with plenty of room to maneuver late. His proven course form and Jamie Snowden's 46% strike rate with the style becomes crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Morning Mayhem faces no early pressure and gets uncontested fractions
scenarios.body: The leader can dictate throughout and prove hard to peg back despite the class deficit. Kielan Woods can time the kick perfectly from the front having controlled the tempo.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes truly crawling with all prominent racers hesitating
scenarios.body: The race turns into a messy sprint where any horse can win regardless of position. Form figures become less reliable when tactical positioning breaks down completely.

watchPoints.text: Morning Mayhem if allowed completely uncontested early fractions could prove very hard to catch despite the class gap
Donnie Azoff's jumping under pressure given his 38-day absence and the need to make up significant ground late
Dream Diamond's fitness levels after 39 days off, though James Owen runners often come forward for these seasonal returns
Siam Park's confidence levels following that recent fall, especially when challenging for the lead
Almuhit showing any signs of his quick turnaround from Tuesday's winning effort affecting his usual prominent racing

races.name: St. Austell Brewery Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: La Pinsonniere
runners_data.note: Front-running type with class edge but 34-day break and recent disappointing form raises fitness questions despite Henderson's skill

runners_data.name: Court In A Storm
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with perfect going record and tongue-tie suggesting wind issues, but sharp recent win shows current form

runners_data.name: Rickety Bridge
runners_data.note: Progressive prominent runner from in-form Nicholls yard with cheekpieces, consecutive wins suggest confidence but OR rise makes task harder

runners_data.name: Dexperts Opinion
runners_data.note: Prominent style from Bowen team hitting form, lightest weight and recent win indicates upward curve despite lowest OR

races.paceDynamic: La Pinsonniere will likely take this field along from the front with Court In A Storm and Rickety Bridge tracking prominently behind. With all four runners showing prominent tendencies and no confirmed hold-up horses, the pace should be genuine but not frantic over this extended trip. The sustained gallop will test stamina reserves, particularly with La Pinsonniere's class advantage allowing him to dictate terms. This setup clearly favors horses with proven staying power and tactical speed who can position prominently and respond when the pace lifts.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Class Tells Over Distance
scenarios.trigger: If La Pinsonniere travels smoothly in front and maintains his jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: His superior OR of 129 and Henderson's expertise will prove decisive as the others struggle to match his sustained gallop up the home straight. De Boinville can control the tempo and kick when ready.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong with multiple horses vying for prominence
scenarios.body: The stamina test will find out those lacking true staying power, allowing the most genuine stayer to pick up the pieces late. Recent winner Dexperts Opinion could benefit from a more patient ride.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Weakens Late
scenarios.trigger: If La Pinsonniere's 34-day absence tells when the pace quickens after the last
scenarios.body: Court In A Storm's excellent going record (9/9 on similar) and recent form upturn under the Bailey-Nicholls partnership becomes crucial. His lighter weight advantage could prove telling.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jumping Errors Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the lead changes hands due to crucial jumping mistakes at key fences
scenarios.body: Rickety Bridge's recent Nicholls polish and back-to-back wins suggest improved jumping confidence that could capitalize on others' errors. His cheekpieces indicate continued focus.

watchPoints.text: La Pinsonniere's jumping rhythm early - any signs of rustiness from his 34-day break could undermine his class advantage
Court In A Storm's position turning in - needs to be within striking distance given his tendency to need strong pace
Rickety Bridge's response when De Boinville kicks on La Pinsonniere - will show if recent wins have given him genuine confidence
Early pace development - if all four go prominent this could become a stamina test rather than tactical battle
Dexperts Opinion's jumping under pressure - needs to stay in touch to utilize his finishing kick

races.name: Sun Racing The Favourite Pullout Every Day Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Cobbler's Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 5lb claim from Harry Atkins, but needs strong early pace which may not materialise in this small field.

runners_data.name: First Angel
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 87-day break with trainer Martin Keighley having limited opportunities this season.

runners_data.name: Beorma
runners_data.note: On a five-race winning streak with Harry Skelton aboard, racing off just one day's rest and well-suited to prominent tactics.

races.paceDynamic: With At The Oche declared as a non-runner, this becomes a tactical affair between three horses all capable of racing prominently. First Angel and Beorma will likely dispute the early lead, with both having prominent tendencies and needing to be positive from the start. Cobbler's Boy sits as the sole hold-up horse but faces the challenge of getting a strong pace to aim at in a small field. The lack of a confirmed front-runner creates uncertainty, but the prominence of First Angel and Beorma should provide enough tempo for this to favour horses that can travel and finish, giving a slight edge to prominent racers who can dictate terms.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Beorma Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Beorma uses his recent winning form to dictate a measured pace from the front.
scenarios.body: His five-race winning streak and Harry Skelton's tactical nous allow him to control the tempo and kick clear when it matters. The good ground suits his recent impressive sequence perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: First Angel Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the veteran's class tells and he finds his best form after a break.
scenarios.body: His previous course form and ability to handle good ground could see Martin Keighley's charge benefit from reduced expectations. The 87-day break might have freshened him up for one more big effort.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Cobbler's Boy Gets Strong Pace
scenarios.trigger: If First Angel and Beorma go too fast early and set it up for the closer.
scenarios.body: The Skelton stable's strong form and Harry Atkins' 5lb claim become decisive factors when the leaders tire. His hold-up style profits from any early pace injection between the prominent pair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Stalemate Benefits Class
scenarios.trigger: If nobody wants to make the running and it becomes a sprint finish.
scenarios.body: The lack of natural pace creates a messy tactical affair where superior class becomes the deciding factor. Beorma's higher rating and winning momentum see him through a slowly-run contest.

watchPoints.text: Watch for Beorma's jumping under pressure - any mistake could derail his winning sequence in a small field.
Monitor the early pace between First Angel and Beorma - if they go too steady it negates Cobbler's Boy's finishing kick.
Observe First Angel's fitness levels early - 87 days off the track is a significant break for a 10-year-old.
Watch Cobbler's Boy's position turning in - if he's too far back in a slowly-run race he may not get there in time.
